name: Bukki
title: Descendant of Aaron in the priestly line
summary: Bukki was the son of Abishua and a descendant of Aaron through the Eleazar line. He is mentioned in the priestly genealogies in 1 Chronicles and in the book of Ezra as part of the high-priestly lineage that led to Ezra. His role is primarily genealogical, but it underscores the continuity of the Levitical priesthood.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Aaron's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Bukki is listed as the son of Abishua in the priestly genealogy that traces back to Aaron through Eleazar.

keyEvents.title: Father of Uzzi
keyEvents.description: Bukki is recorded as the father of Uzzi, who carried on the priestly line.

keyEvents.title: Part of Ezra's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: In the book of Ezra, Bukki is mentioned as part of the lineage leading from Aaron all the way to the priest Ezra.

keyEvents.title: Continuity in the Priesthood After Phinehas
keyEvents.description: Bukki represents the continuation of the holy priesthood after his grandfather Phinehas, who was known for his zeal for the Lord.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogy in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Bukki is included in the extensive genealogy in 1 Chronicles, which documents Israel's tribal history and the Levitical families.
